name: Valencian nationalism
summary: Valencian nationalism (valencianisme) seeks recognition and political self-government for the Valencian people, centred on the Valencian language and culture. Its mainstream since the 1960s, shaped by Joan Fuster, sees the Valencians as part of a wider Catalan-speaking community, and today it is carried by the BNV within the left, green and republican Compromís coalition. In practice it pursues a fairer financing deal, a broader statute of autonomy and European integration, with the ultimate aim of full sovereignty for the Valencian people.
scope: The Fusterian, left-leaning mainstream of Valencian nationalism from Joan Fuster's Nosaltres, els valencians (1962) to the Compromis coalition (BNV and allies) as shown in its 2023 election program for the Corts Valencianes. It excludes Blaverism, the anti-Catalanist regionalism that treats Valencian as a separate language and is often described as Spanish-nationalist. Answers on economic and social issues reflect the Compromis program because Valencianism has no founding economic doctrine.

keyFigures.name: Joan Fuster
keyFigures.role: Essayist whose Nosaltres, els valencians (1962) founded modern Valencianism and popularised the term Paisos Catalans.

keyFigures.name: Faustí Barberà
keyFigures.role: Author of the 1902 lecture treated as the symbolic birth of political Valencianism.

universal-healthcare.rationale: The Compromís program makes a fully public health system its first service priority and returns privatised health departments to direct public management.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: The program pegs the Generalitat's social benefits to the minimum wage and pursues better wages and labour rights, in line with its left-wing orientation.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: The program speaks of an economy at the service of people, with industrial policy and public promotion funds, rather than trusting markets to allocate.

public-ownership.rationale: The program reverses privatisations of health and services but does not call for nationalising energy or rail; adherents differ between green-left and moderate wings.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: The left-wing coalition seeks more public-service funding, which implies heavier taxation of high incomes, though its headline demand is fair regional financing rather than tax rates.

unions-good.rationale: The program defends labour rights and collective-agreement wages, treating organised labour as a partner of its left-wing politics.

property-fundamental.rationale: A left-green coalition accepts limits on property for housing, land use and the climate, so an absolute property right is not its position.

regulate-corporations.rationale: The program audits production chains, restricts unfair competition and sets public conditions on public contracts, which implies tighter regulation.

cut-welfare.rationale: The program expands social services, social benefits and public health, and rejects welfare cuts as a matter of its core left platform.

worker-ownership.rationale: The program supports cooperatives and the social economy but not collective worker ownership as a general principle; not an identifying position.

surveillance-ok.rationale: A civil-liberties-minded progressive coalition is unlikely to accept broad surveillance, though the programme does not discuss the question; inferred.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; Valencian left-green adherents are split between decriminalisation and caution, so this is left neutral.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: The program backs anti-discrimination and anti-hate measures for LGTBIQ+, migrants and Roma people; inferred support for legal limits.

strong-leader.rationale: The movement stresses participatory democracy and transparency, which is at odds with a leader bypassing institutions.

state-harmful.rationale: The program is built around using the Generalitat and public services actively, and nationalists seek more state powers for the Valencian institutions.

limit-guns.rationale: Not discussed in the program; inferred from its progressive profile and the Spanish consensus on strict gun control.

empower-police-military.rationale: The program's security section centres on emergency response and local police coordination, not expanding coercive power; inferred.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Not addressed; Valencian left and feminist adherents are split between abolitionist and regulationist views.

decide-locally.rationale: The program asks for more competences for the Generalitat and local government with a financing system giving towns their own fiscal space.

rehabilitation.rationale: The program's justice and social sections favour rehabilitation and social reintegration, in line with its progressive profile.

traditional-family.rationale: The program has sections on LGTBIQ+, family diversity and feminisms and treats many family forms as valid, so it does not call the traditional family foundational.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: A dedicated LGTBIQ+ section and its feminist and rights platform make equal marriage a settled position.

abortion-legal.rationale: The program defends sexual and reproductive rights and feminism, which implies support for legal abortion in most cases.

more-religion-public.rationale: The movement is secular-progressive and Fuster was a critic of clerical influence; the program has no pro-religion agenda.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: The program backs integration of Roma people and migrants and anti-racism, though racial history is not its main frame.

gender-social-construct.rationale: The program is explicitly feminist and trans-inclusive; the statement is not discussed directly, so this is an inference.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Valencian nationalism is defined by recognition and promotion of the Valencian language and culture, and the program funds their protection.

gradual-change.rationale: Nationalists seek statute and constitutional reform within existing institutions while also pushing for deep change in social policy; split.

reduce-immigration.rationale: The program's migration section calls for a more solidary policy, full access to services and refugee reception.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: The program is strongly pro-European and wants Valencian regions and languages heard in EU institutions; support for the UN is inferred.

free-trade.rationale: The program protects Valencian farmers from unfair third-country competition and favours food sovereignty; inferred scepticism.

nation-first.rationale: The program stresses a European and Mediterranean vocation and international cooperation, not the primacy of national interest.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Not discussed; left-green Valencianists are split between human-rights interventionism and anti-war pacifism.

open-borders.rationale: The program favours welcoming, solidary migration policy but proposes no abolition of borders; adherents differ.

limit-growth.rationale: The program pursues green transition and circular economy while still promoting industry and tourism growth; the wings differ.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: The program has a full section on responding to the climate emergency and the Green party Equo sits in the coalition.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: The program backs innovation and technological sovereignty but is not techno-optimist; inferred neutral.

expand-nuclear.rationale: The program demands a closing date for the Cofrents nuclear plant, and ecologism is a core component.

revolution-justified.rationale: The movement works through elections and statutes of autonomy; revolution is not its tradition.

experts-over-public.rationale: The program stresses participation and citizens' assemblies, so it does not want experts to override the public.

central-planning.rationale: The program supports an active industrial policy within a mixed market economy, not a centrally planned economy.

socialized-markets.rationale: No source takes a position; the program supports cooperatives and public services within a mixed economy.

land-value-tax.rationale: Not addressed; no tradition within Valencianism favours a land value tax.

tax-inheritance.rationale: A left coalition would plausibly favour taxing large inheritances, though the source does not state it.

basic-income.rationale: The program emphasises minimum-income benefits tied to the minimum wage rather than a universal basic income; split.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: The program defends local farmers against unfair competition, but as an EU member it does not advocate national tariffs.

state-directs-investment.rationale: The program proposes an industrial promotion fund and a strategy for the Valencian economic model, which is state-directed investment.

widespread-small-property.rationale: The program defends small farms, small commerce and cooperatives but does not frame property distribution as a principle.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: The program works to improve wages and labour rights inside the current economy; abolition is not on any adherent's agenda.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Nothing in Valencianism favours abolishing central banks; inferred from its pro-European, mainstream-economics stance.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: The program backs collective bargaining but not state-recognised bodies setting wages and prices; inferred.

one-party-rule.rationale: The coalition is a democratic electoral alliance committed to participatory democracy and electoral reform.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Compromís is listed as republican in ideology and Valencian nationalists are mostly critical of the Spanish monarchy.

democracy-best.rationale: The program centres on a more modern and participatory democracy with transparency and better governance.

direct-votes.rationale: The program expands participation and citizen initiatives, though representative institutions remain central; mild support.

workers-councils.rationale: The movement operates in parliamentary and municipal democracy; workers' councils are not part of its programme.

right-to-secede.rationale: The BNV's aim is full sovereignty for the Valencian people, but the mainstream stresses reform and federal options; self-determination in principle is a mild yes.

natural-rulers.rationale: The left-democratic, egalitarian platform rejects any claim that some are born to rule.

political-violence-never.rationale: The movement is non-violent and electoral, and the memory programme condemns violence and repression; Fuster was himself target of bombings.

war-builds-character.rationale: The program stresses peace, cooperation and humanitarian aid, with no glorification of war.

separate-church-state.rationale: The secular-progressive program has no religious content, and Valencianism is not clerical; moderate support for separation.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: The program is secular and rights-based, with no role for religious scripture in law.

private-courts-defense.rationale: The program centres on strengthening public justice and security services.

military-superiority.rationale: The program emphasises civil emergency response and cooperation, not military power; inferred.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Valencian nationalism defines the nation by language, culture and residence, and the program is inclusive of migrants.

class-struggle-history.rationale: The program's left politics acknowledges social inequality but does not adopt a class-struggle theory of history.

equal-outcomes.rationale: The program pursues social cohesion and equity but frames this as equal opportunity and universal services; split.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Not applicable to Valencia; the program is silent, so this is neutral.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Not discussed; the program supports development cooperation but the statement is not part of Valencianism.

civilizational-union.rationale: The program favours European and Mediterranean cooperation, not union on religious or civilizational grounds.

self-interest-moral.rationale: A solidarity-oriented left platform does not hold self-interest as a moral good.

duties-before-rights.rationale: The program expands individual and social rights in an extended statute of autonomy.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: The green component and a section on animal welfare reflect a view that nature and animals matter in themselves.

limit-population.rationale: Not discussed; Valencian adherents do not take this up, and the program has a pro-family section.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: The program backs green transition inside a modern economy, not a rejection of industrial civilization.

accelerate-technology.rationale: The program promotes technological innovation but carefully and socially; inferred neutral.

human-enhancement.rationale: Neither the program nor Valencianist sources discuss body or mind enhancement, so there is no basis for a position.

algorithmic-government.rationale: The program stresses transparency and participation, and does not favour handing decisions to algorithms; inferred.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Not discussed; a civil-liberties-minded left tends to support privacy.

restore-past-order.rationale: The movement is progressive and forward-looking; its historical references concern recovering democratic memory and language rights, not a past social order.

results-over-ideology.rationale: The program is openly ideological (Valencianist, progressive, ecologist) but also governs pragmatically; split.

direct-action.rationale: The coalition works through elections, parliaments and institutions.

means-match-ends.rationale: The sources do not discuss the ethics of means.

return-to-foraging.rationale: No strand of Valencian nationalism entertains it.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: The program organises work around employment, professional training and wages.

distribute-by-need.rationale: The program backs universal public services based on need, but not a goods distribution principle; neutral.

production-for-use.rationale: The program frames economy as at the service of people while operating within markets; split.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Not stated in the program; the coalition's left wing may agree, the green wing may not.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: The program is a democratic electoral platform that rejects dictatorship of any kind.

collective-farming.rationale: The program supports family farms, agrarian cooperatives and rural development, not collectivised agriculture.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: The sources do not address this Leninist thesis.

taxation-theft.rationale: The program relies on public funding for services and demands fair financing from the state.

harm-principle.rationale: Not discussed; the movement is socially liberal but supports many public-purpose limits.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Valencian nationalism claims collective language and national rights, as the program's linguistic rights section shows, besides individual rights.

conscription.rationale: Spain has abolished conscription and the program does not advocate its return; inferred.

exit-over-voice.rationale: The program centres on democratic voice, participation and representation.

state-as-business.rationale: The program stresses public services as rights and rejects market-style management of the state.

positive-liberty.rationale: The program's social-rights approach ties freedom to material conditions such as housing, education and health.

media-academia-power.rationale: The program supports public media and universities and does not see them as dominating elected officials.

hereditarian-race.rationale: The program is anti-racist and the statement has no place in Valencianism.

organic-representation.rationale: The program supports electoral reform and party-based parliamentary democracy.

total-state.rationale: The program protects civil rights and participation.

national-rebirth.rationale: Valencianism speaks of cultural revival from the Renaixença on, but not of rebirth from decadence in a radical sense; neutral.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Valencian nationalism does not claim foreign territory and the program is cooperative.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: The program is a democratic platform with no place for rule by personal oaths.

bound-labor.rationale: The program defends labour rights and rural development; serfdom is rejected.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Epistemological debate not addressed in the sources.

universal-morality.rationale: Not discussed; left progressives are split between universalist and relativist views.

single-common-good.rationale: The program's pluralist, participatory politics assumes balancing competing interests.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; Valencian left opinion is split.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: The program supports Valencians abroad via support for CEVEX centres but does not take up a right of return; neutral.

revive-national-language.rationale: The program creates a language strategy to raise social use of Valencian and a new law securing linguistic equality; Fusterian valencianism makes the language central.

workplace-democracy.rationale: The program supports participation and cooperatives, so some voice for workers in company governance is consistent; inferred.

school-vouchers.rationale: The program increases funding of public education and improves conditions in publicly funded private schools without endorsing vouchers.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: The program wants more spending and investment and demands debt regularisation from the state.

economic-freedom.rationale: The program is left-wing, linking freedom to social rights rather than economic liberty.

rule-by-example.rationale: The program relies on law, transparency and good governance rules instead of rulers' example.

national-self-determination.rationale: The movement advocates political sovereignty of the Valencian people; self-determination is a core claim.

force-without-un.rationale: The program's international orientation is multilateral and pro-European; inferred.

reason-over-faith.rationale: The sources do not address faith and reason.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: The migration section guarantees migrants and asylum seekers normal access to public services and benefits.

work-for-welfare.rationale: The program ties benefits to the minimum wage and provides social inclusion services without punitive work requirements.

class-collaboration.rationale: The coalition supports social dialogue but its left wing uses class language; split.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: The program funds museums, libraries and cultural heritage and Valencianism is built on cultural revival.

dominated-front.rationale: The program is pro-European and west-aligned; no such front is proposed.

workers-nation.rationale: The left of Valencianism is internationalist in the European sense and does not organise workers on national lines as a doctrine.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: The program has a major feminism section committed to gender equality and parity.

ban-interest.rationale: Nothing in Valencianism calls for banning interest.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: The program is anti-racist and calls for inclusion and non-discrimination.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Not stated; neutral between marxist and liberal-democratic views of the state.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: The program bans fracking, promotes renewables and a 100% renewable electricity system.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: The migration section promotes interculturality and the protection of immigrants' own languages.

elite-replacement.rationale: The program supports solidarity with migrants and has no place for conspiracy claims.

proportional-representation.rationale: The program reforms the electoral law to make it more democratic and representative.

national-mission.rationale: Valencianism seeks recognition for its own people, not to spread its government elsewhere.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: The program's feminism section addresses gender gaps in pay, care and violence as structural.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: The program has a transparency and anti-corruption chapter; the PP corruption scandals fed the coalition's rise.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Nothing in the program supports eugenics; it protects disability rights.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: The memory programme seeks investigation of human-rights violations and recognising victims of the dictatorship.

night-watchman-state.rationale: The program assigns the Generalitat a large role in health, education and social services.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: The program is anti-racist and pro-diversity.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The program's rights and anti-discrimination sections rest on equal rights.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Valencianism is not a Marxist-Leninist tradition and never addressed this doctrinal question.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: The sources do not take a position on settler colonial states.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: The program demands recovery of Valencian civil law, valuing regional legal diversity.

restrict-conversion.rationale: The program protects freedom of belief and rights.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Valencianism has no such agenda; animal welfare targets bullfighting subsidies, not cattle slaughter.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: The secular-progressive education program does not provide for religious instruction; inferred.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: The program is not communist and rejects state-strengthening of that kind.

consent-of-governed.rationale: The program rests on democratic participation and sovereignty of the Valencian people.

trade-surplus.rationale: Not part of the program; mercantilism is not a Valencianist position.

population-transfer.rationale: The program rejects discrimination and supports inclusion of migrants and minorities.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: The non-aggression principle is a libertarian doctrine the sources do not discuss.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: The program stresses cooperation and solidarity.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Not discussed; split between militant-democracy and free-speech instincts.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: The republican side of the coalition would sympathise, but the source does not use this concept; inferred.

separated-powers.rationale: The program defends institutional independence, transparency and good governance of justice and administration.

vanguard-party.rationale: The coalition is a democratic alliance of parties; vanguard leadership is foreign to it.

priority-to-poor.rationale: The program gives priority to social services, housing and anti-exclusion measures.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: The program builds a public housing inventory and expands public stock, which cuts against selling it off; inferred.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: The program defends labour rights, and restricting strikes would be contrary to it.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: The program attributes poverty to social and economic institutions.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: The program's migration and interculturality sections hold the opposite.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: The program supports citizens' assemblies but not filling offices by lottery.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: The program defends rights and denounces repression, as its memory section shows.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: The program does not discuss price ceilings for food.

party-controls-media.rationale: The program reforms public broadcasting to make it independent and transparent.

party-commands-army.rationale: A democratic coalition does not support party command of the army.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: The migration section seeks inclusive treatment of migrants.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Not stated; adherents may favour austere salaries for politicians but it is not program content.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: The program does not address internal party discipline.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: The program reaffirms a European vocation and wants regions to play a greater role in EU policy-making.

head-commands-forces.rationale: A republican, parliamentary coalition would not give the head of state this power.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Church governance is not a political question for Valencian nationalism, which has no position on it.

clerical-rule.rationale: The program is secular and democratic, so clerical rule is rejected.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Not a Valencianist stance; inferred from the movement's institutional, non-revolutionary character.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: The program promotes culture and freedom of expression.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: The program promotes transparency and democratic renewal, which does not accord with unlimited re-election; inferred.

recall-officials.rationale: The program expands citizen participation and democratic accountability; inferred.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Not addressed; left Valencianists are split on NATO.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: The program expands public rental housing and rental support, which assumes renting remains.

people-in-arms.rationale: Not part of Valencianism; inferred from its civilian institutional character.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: The program supports rural development but makes no moral claim about rural life.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Fusterians favour closer cultural and political ties among the Catalan Countries, though with different strengths of commitment.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Valencianism is rooted in universities and intellectuals such as Fuster; the statement is contrary.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: The program supports linguistic equality and diversity; inferred.

death-penalty.rationale: The program's human-rights stance and Spain's constitution exclude it.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: The program includes sex and equality education in schools.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: The program has a secular, science-based education platform.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Not discussed; feminist wing may favour restrictions but others do not.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Valencian nationalism defines membership by residence and language, and its migration policy is inclusive.

minority-language-support.rationale: The program creates a new language law and strategy and asks for minority languages in the EU Committee of the Regions.

religious-exemptions.rationale: The sources do not discuss exemptions for religious minorities.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Inferred from socially liberal outlook; not stated.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: The program supports development cooperation, but debt cancellation is inferred.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: The sources do not link sovereignty to changing the economic system.

constituent-assembly.rationale: The program seeks reform of the statute of autonomy within the constitutional order, not an assembly; neutral.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: The program rejects restricting political freedoms.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: The program has a cooperation chapter committed to development aid.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: The coalition is anti-nuclear in all forms.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Compromís is republican, but the sources do not say how a head of state should be chosen, so no position is recorded.

central-bank-independence.rationale: The program is silent on central banking, which is set at the European level.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Not a Valencianist question; inferred from the movement's general peace orientation.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: The program ties property to social function in housing and land-use policy.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: A debate within Marxism that Valencianism never took up.

precautionary-principle.rationale: The program's environment section favours preventive action, including the nuclear closure and a fracking ban.

collective-defense.rationale: The program says nothing about alliance obligations.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: A rights-based internationalist stance would agree; inferred.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Not discussed; secular but not anticlerical in programme.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: Not discussed; republicans would prefer an elected one but the principle is neutral.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: A nationalist movement that favours self-determination opposes using force against regions.

region-keeps-system.rationale: The program seeks to extend and shield Generalitat competences and restore Valencian civil law within Spain.

sacred-ruler.rationale: The movement is republican and secular.

flat-income-tax.rationale: The left program favours progressive financing of public services.

character-from-environment.rationale: Inferred from progressive social policy emphasis on education and social inclusion.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: The program emphasises transparency, good governance and rule-bound administration.

space-expansion.rationale: Not part of the program; the green wing disfavours it.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Classical constitutional theory the sources do not engage with.

equal-parenting.rationale: The program has a family section but does not take a position on equal custody; neutral.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: A debate internal to communist movements that is outside Valencianism.

land-redistribution.rationale: The program backs small farmers but does not call for taking estates; inferred.

refugee-return.rationale: The program backs refugee reception and rights; inferred for return rights.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Fusterian ideas of Catalan Countries are cultural and political cooperation, not state irredentism, though critics read them that way.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: The program protects freedom of belief.

women-must-cover.rationale: The program's feminism section rejects this.

common-currency.rationale: The program is pro-European and favours EU monetary integration.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Fuster's thesis proposed the political unity of Catalan-speaking peoples; the program speaks of cooperation with Catalan-speaking territories.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Valencianism seeks territorial autonomy and sovereignty rather than minority cultural autonomy; neutral.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: The question concerns diaspora minorities seeking a homeland, which does not apply to the Valencians.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: A Marxist theory of history that the Valencianist sources do not endorse or reject.

ban-cartels.rationale: The program regulates unfair competition and supports small business; inferred.

no-bailouts.rationale: The program does not discuss bank or corporate bailouts.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: The program entrenches rights and institutional checks.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: The program supports parity and participation of women in public bodies.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: The program is European and Mediterranean in outlook, and not autarkic.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: The program defends European labour and environmental standards against unfair competition.

moral-incentives.rationale: A Guevarist idea absent from Valencianism; inferred.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: The movement is non-violent and electoral.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Compromís is republican, opposed to hereditary privilege.

history-own-civilization.rationale: The program emphasises Valencian culture in education, with caveats; inferred.

patriotic-education.rationale: The program promotes Valencian language and culture in schools but not flag-and-anthem pride education; neutral.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Inferred from the left's inclusion stance.

public-money-creation.rationale: Monetary reform is not part of the program or of Valencianist writing.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: The sources do not discuss capitalism's crisis tendencies.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Valencianism as a minority nationalism is critical of Spanish imperial legacies; inferred.

delink-world-market.rationale: The program wants global integration under fair rules.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: A Leninist concept absent from Valencianist sources.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: The program wants the statute of autonomy to broaden rights and shield them.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: The sources do not discuss colonial-era treaties.

elective-rulers.rationale: The republican coalition favours elected heads of state.

minority-veto.rationale: Not stated; inferred from its majoritarian democratic procedures.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Resistance theory is not addressed in the sources.

parliament-supreme.rationale: The program places Corts Valencianes at the centre of democratic institutions; inferred.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: The program has a full animal-welfare section and ends public funding of bullfighting-type spectacles.

animal-use-humane.rationale: The program regulates animal protection and supports farming; the green wing leans abolitionist while the farming side accepts humane use.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Not a framework Valencianism uses; it prefers rights and public services over elite duty.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: A movement built around participation and participatory democracy rejects withdrawal.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Critical theory is not addressed in the sources.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Gramscian theory is not addressed in the sources.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Not addressed globally, though the program does claim the Valencian region is shortchanged within Spain.

native-born-offices.rationale: The program is inclusive of migrants and rejects such a restriction.

party-own-road.rationale: A question about communist parties that does not apply to Valencian nationalism.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: The program supports development aid and international cooperation; inferred.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Valencianism has no irredentist claims and the program is cooperative.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Not applicable; equal democratic rights are the program's stance.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: The memory chapter commits to recognising victims of the dictatorship and annulling political sentences.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: The memory policy is aimed at Francoist repression; equating communism and fascism is not its framing.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Not a Valencianist stance; inferred from a progressive view of history.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: The memory policy seeks to remove symbols honouring the dictatorship and promote democratic memory.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: The program is feminist and focuses on gender gaps against women; inferred neutral on male disadvantage.

domestic-violence-symmetry.rationale: The program treats gender violence as violence against women; inferred.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: The program holds to European democratic institutions but does not debate civilizational fit.

military-guardian-role.rationale: The coalition is democratic-civilian, opposed to military political roles.

paid-care-work.rationale: The program creates a Valencian care strategy and pay equity measures.

filial-duty.rationale: The program's family chapter does not discuss duties of adult children.

office-by-exam.rationale: Civil-service recruitment method is not addressed beyond language requirements.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: The program backs technological sovereignty and public interest but does not discuss blocking foreign takeovers.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: The program's social liberalism supports individual freedom in family law.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Imperative mandate is not mentioned in the program.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: The program defends public welfare institutions and does not favour private pension accounts.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Not part of the program; it supports land-owning farmers and families.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: The program centres on parliamentary democracy and transparency in budgets.

single-official-language.rationale: The program's linguistic rights chapter seeks plural linguistic equality and official EU status for Valencian.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Not part of the program; inferred inclusive stance.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: US-style disparate-impact doctrine is not discussed.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: The green component and circular-economy chapter oppose excessive consumption.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: The program's international stance emphasises cooperation and peace.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Contrary to the pro-sovereignty, democratic outlook of the movement.

corporate-influence.rationale: The transparency and anti-corruption chapter addresses influence on politics.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: The program backs civil liberties and transparency; inferred.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: The program has family supports, but not an explicit pronatalist plan; neutral.

residents-only-property.rationale: The program regulates housing speculation, but this exact measure is not stated; neutral.

job-guarantee.rationale: Not stated; the program has an employment chapter but not a guarantee.

democratic-peace.rationale: Inferred from its pro-European, pro-democratic worldview.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: The program relies on rule of law and statutory reform; inferred.

non-intervention.rationale: Not addressed; split between non-intervention and human rights interventions.

industrial-unions.rationale: Union organisation form is not discussed.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: The program rejects discrimination against any minority.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: The program supports legal equal marriage and family rights; inferred.

public-access-to-information.rationale: The transparency chapter seeks open access to public information.

local-production.rationale: The program backs local food systems, short supply chains and food sovereignty.

informal-organisation.rationale: The coalition is a party-based electoral alliance.

national-law-over-international.rationale: The program is pro-European and rights-oriented; inferred.

religious-nation.rationale: The nation is defined by language and culture and the program is secular.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: The program seeks cooperation among equals in Europe and rejects tribute relations between states.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: The program demands fair financing but within a solidarity model, not full retention; adherents differ between wings.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Not addressed since Valencianism is not about common ownership of production.

defeat-communism.rationale: The coalition is left-wing; an anti-communist crusade is not its position.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: The program re-municipalises privatised health services rather than mixing providers.

religion-illusion.rationale: The sources do not state a view on religion's origins.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: The sources do not state a historical judgement on capitalism.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: The program ties gender equality to pay equity, care and work reforms; inferred.

socialized-care.rationale: The program creates a Valencian care strategy and expands public social services; inferred.

purge-loanwords.rationale: The language policy promotes use, not purism; inferred.

treaties-binding.rationale: The sources do not address treaties between a state and nations within it.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Not addressed; the program supports cooperatives but not small communities as organising principle.

majority-settlement.rationale: The program is inclusive and has no policy of encouraging settlement.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Third-way framing is not used in the sources.

historical-land-claim.rationale: The sources do not frame claims to land by historical tie.

holocaust-denial.rationale: The coalition's memory policy opposes denialism and affirms victims' recognition.

suppress-opposition.rationale: The program values pluralism, transparency and participation.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: The program supports secular rights and expression.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Contrary to its stance on fair treatment of territories.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: A religious doctrine that does not apply to this ideology.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: The program is secular and democratic.

participatory-democracy.rationale: The program includes a participation chapter and a statute reform that brings a more participatory democracy.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: The program combines feminism, anti-racism, LGTBIQ+ and social policy in an intersectional way.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: The LGTBIQ+ chapter supports recognition and protection.

alienated-labor.rationale: A Marxist concept the sources do not take up.

islam-incompatible.rationale: The program embraces interculturality and inclusion.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: The movement bases authority on popular sovereignty.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: The feminism chapter targets harassment; inferred support.

social-market-economy.rationale: The program's mixed economy with strong public services fits.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: The program does not mention armed forces, and adherents differ.

rich-first.rationale: The program stresses solidarity and fair financing.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: The program does not take a position on military blocs.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Mutualist credit schemes are not addressed in the sources.

property-franchise.rationale: The democratic program rejects limiting suffrage.

domination-women-nature.rationale: Not stated; eco-feminism is present but not defined in the program.

reification.rationale: A Marxist concept the sources do not take up.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: The program backs independent public media but doesn't state this claim.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Inferred from its rule-of-law and good-governance emphasis.

online-participation.rationale: The participation chapter encourages digital tools; inferred.

open-government-data.rationale: The transparency chapter commits to open government data.

citizens-assembly.rationale: The program establishes a citizens' climate assembly and promotes citizens' assemblies.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Valencian nationalism is secular and the sources do not address religious reform.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: The program protects freedom of belief.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: The program funds emergency and local police services.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Consociational theory is not addressed in the sources.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: The program emphasises public social services over charity.

term-limits.rationale: The program does not mention limits on terms of office.

vote-delegation.rationale: Liquid democracy is not mentioned in the program.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: Not addressed; climate emergency is its main risk.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: The program's feminism rejects male household authority.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: The inclusive migration chapter makes this plausible; inferred.

rent-control.rationale: The housing chapter supports rent regulation measures in stressed areas; inferred.

abolish-ip.rationale: The program supports innovation and cultural industries; inferred.

uniformed-youth.rationale: The youth chapter focuses on participation, education and services, with no drilled national youth movement.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: The program does not discuss foreign bases.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Inferred from its rights and memory policy.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Pacifism of this absolute kind is not in the sources; inferred.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Valencianism recounts a history of repression and revival, with a modern nation building, rather than unbroken continuity.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Academic gender theory is not addressed in the sources.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: Feminist theory debate not addressed in the sources.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Not part of its secular discourse, though victims of Francoism are honoured.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: CEVEX centres abroad suggest a role for homeland ties, but not as doctrine.

culture-before-state.rationale: Valencianism began as a cultural revival (Renaixença) and the language remains its central cause.

god-not-male.rationale: Theological language is outside the sources.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: Feminist theology is outside the sources.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Fusterian valencianism claims cultural and national unity of Catalan-speaking territories, though political merger is contested.

independent-unions.rationale: The program supports collective bargaining independent of the state.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: A debate internal to socialism, not taken up by the sources.

local-essentials-public.rationale: The program restores public management of health and supports public transport and local services.

second-chamber.rationale: The sources do not discuss a second legislative chamber.

municipal-property.rationale: Municipalist ownership theory is not discussed by the sources.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Confederalist municipalism is not addressed in the sources.

family-wage.rationale: The program supports pay equity and minimum wage but not a family wage.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Regulatory speed on drugs is not part of the program.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: Not part of the program or of Valencianist writing.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Not part of the program or of Valencianist writing.

online-anonymity.rationale: Not part of the program or of Valencianist writing.

spiritual-nature.rationale: The sources are secular and do not address human spiritual nature.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: The program demands to shield and widen Generalitat competences against being reduced.

gm-crops.rationale: The green component and food sovereignty favour caution.

dense-cities.rationale: The program has urbanism chapters but no explicit position; neutral.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Fuster's thesis defines the Catalan nation by shared language and history across borders, the Fusterian mainstream view; the Blaverist wing disagrees.

free-public-college.rationale: The program expands scholarships and university funding.

pollution-taxes.rationale: The green program supports polluter-pays measures.

future-generations.rationale: The environmental chapter addresses climate emergency.

women-distinct-values.rationale: The program frames equality in rights and structural terms.

arms-reduction.rationale: Not stated; inferred from the movement's peace and anti-nuclear orientation.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Not stated; inferred from its emphasis on transparency in government.

capital-controls.rationale: Capital movement rules are set at EU level and the program is silent on them.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Not stated; inferred from its democratic, civilian outlook.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: The program does not discuss soldiers refusing orders.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Tax credits for low-paid work are not mentioned in the program.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: The program calls for debt regularisation and more investment.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Inferred from its international cooperation stance.

smash-state-machine.rationale: The coalition participates in state institutions.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: A libertarian proposal the sources do not address.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Green wing sees nature as intrinsic.

sacred-nation.rationale: Valencianism treats the nation as a cultural and political community, not a sacred one; its language is secular.

student-debt-relief.rationale: The program expands scholarships but says nothing on student debt, which is rare in Spain.

internal-colonialism.rationale: The program claims chronic underfunding and unequal investment by the central state.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Philosophical anthropology is not addressed in the sources.

public-service-media.rationale: The program reforms the public broadcaster to ensure independence and transparency.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Comparative theology is outside the sources.

farm-price-support.rationale: The program supports farmers and fair prices; inferred.

workers-own-party.rationale: The program is that of a coalition and does not address the question of a labour party.

ban-fgm.rationale: The program's feminism and rights chapter supports prohibition.

one-language-many-names.rationale: Fusterians hold Valencian and Catalan to be one language, but allow the name Valencian (the program uses valencià) and Valencian is now recognised by the AVL.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: The program uses public regulation, and does not discuss tort liability.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: The program does not rank environmental protection against liberty.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: The program promotes learning Valencian but does not require it; split between voluntary and compulsory.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: Closed-shop rules are not discussed in the program.

voter-id.rationale: Not stated; inferred from its participation and inclusion emphasis.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Not addressed; adherents treat democracy as procedural but also social.

premarital-sex.rationale: Not stated; inferred from its socially liberal feminist platform.

negative-income-tax.rationale: Not part of the program, which prefers minimum-income benefits.

women-suffrage.rationale: Basic equality in the feminist program.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: The sources say nothing on religion and women's oppression.

race-social-construct.rationale: Not stated; inferred from its anti-racist platform.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: The program creates gender equality bodies and strategies.

missingStatements.text: Revenue-sharing between a state's regions should be reformed so that no region contributes far more than it receives in public investment.
missingStatements.rationale: Fair regional financing and settlement of the historic debt open the Compromis 2023 program as its first priority.
missingStatements.declined: Spain-specific fiscal balance; regional-revenue-retention already answered and captures the axis.

missingStatements.text: A regional language that is spoken in several regions under different names should have its common linguistic unity recognised by public institutions.
missingStatements.rationale: Fusterian Valencianism holds Valencian and Catalan to be one language, but Blaverists reject this and the program uses the name Valencian.

missingStatements.text: Regions of a state should have their own regional civil law restored and protected.
missingStatements.rationale: The program calls for effective recovery of Valencian civil law as part of defending Valencian self-government.
missingStatements.declined: Regional civil law is a Spain-specific demand; too narrow for the bank.

notes: Valencian nationalism is internally divided: Fusterians see Valencia within the Catalan Countries, while Blaverism rejects this; the profile follows the Fusterian mainstream. Compromis in practice pursues autonomy reform and federal options, not immediate independence, so the secession answers are cautious.
